text:
nina: dropping a quick mock for the compact SLO + burst panel. fig link: https://www.figma.com/file/example-compact (mock)

raf: looks promising. main question: does compact mode preserve enough context so users don't misconfigure max?

nina: intent: compact row shows Min | Max (numeric), tiny SLO pill, and a chevron to expand. hover or tap shows est latency/cost + pool that handles burst.

jade: prefer inline tiny text under max: 'est. tail latency • est. $/hr' instead of tooltip-only. tooltips are hidden on mobile.

samir: engineering: we can calculate est values from recent telemetry; need to know if we should show 95th or 99th by default. recommend 95th.

aria (a11y): compact UI mustn't rely on hover. collapse summary should be focusable and expand with Enter. SLO pill needs aria-label like 'SLO: 95th = 200ms'.

raf: copy tweak: avoid jargon in compact mode. 'Max GPUs' -> 'Max (scale-to)'. 'Min GPUs' -> 'Min (reserved)'.

nina: good. proposal for burst wording: label in expanded: 'Burst capacity (short-term extra GPUs)'. compact: just 'Burst'.

jade: add a fallback indicator: if pool could miss SLO, show small amber dot with tooltip 'may fallback'. but again, not tooltip-only; include accessible text next to it for screen readers.

samir: backend: we'll add a boolean "slo_risk" to the pool status API. frontend can render amber dot and alt text.

aria (a11y): ensure all status icons have aria-hidden false with aria-labels. also color contrast for amber dot must meet 3:1 for non-text or 4.5:1 if used with text.

nina: timeline: i'll update figma with the compact prompt and expand flows today. raf, can you validate copy by EOD?

raf: yes, will review. ops-bot: Reminder: product sync at 3pm tomorrow.
